name: Hong Kong SAR, China
headline: Hong Kong SAR, China: +3.6% growth in 2025, 1.4% inflation, debt 12% of GDP
sections: Hong Kong SAR, China is a $427 billion economy (2025), the world's 41st-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.6% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $80K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 0.9% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose 1.4% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges. Unemployment stood at 3.6% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 9.0% (2025).
Gross government debt is 12% of GDP (2025), a low level that has risen from 1% in 2020. The general government balance is −4.5% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is +12.3% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 397% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 28.3% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 20% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 85.4 years (2024). Population: 7.5 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
